title: Pin codex's review model in osf.toml
summary: This change adds an explicit model for the codex reviewer in this repository's own osf.toml, because codex's built-in default (gpt-6-astra) returned 401 against the review environment's API key. The reviewers list itself is untouched, so the roster still resolves to codex, claude, opencode in that order. The accompanying test drops its model assertions entirely — including the ones for claude and opencode — on the grounds that a pinned model name goes stale every few weeks, so the test now only asserts reviewer order and names.
